headline: VNPAY and Napas deepen cooperation on digital payments - VnExpress International
summary: VNPAY and Napas agreed to expand cooperation on next-generation payment technologies. The aim is to speed digital payment adoption and strengthen financial connectivity in Vietnam.
why: VNPAY is a Vietnamese payments company and Napas is the national interbank switch, so their cooperation affects how electronic payments flow in Vietnam.
